situation.en: Requested SKU/quantity not fully in stock and/or restock is after the requested ship date, customer does not insist on exact item/date

action.en: Inform the customer of on-hand quantity and restock date; propose options such as shipping available quantity now and remainder after restock, waiting for full restock, or substituting with an in-stock item. Do not quote the original SKU for the requested ship date if restock is after that date. May create a mixed original+substitute quote and an all-substitute alternative. If a substitute is offered because of a stockout, offer an apology discount within worker discount authority and seek owner approval when the worker has no authority.

unknowns.en: Whether a substitute is always offered when one exists
What discount level is used for an apology discount on a substitute
What is done if there is no restock date or no substitute

settled.question: Whether a substitute is always offered when one exists
settled.ko: Offer a substitute when, by your own judgement, it is close enough that the customer could use it.
settled.en: Offer a substitute when, by your own judgement, it is close enough that the customer could use it.

settled.question: What discount level is used for an apology discount on a substitute
settled.ko: The apology discount on a substitute is the smallest discount: about 1% when your authority runs 1 to 5%. It is a token of goodwill.
settled.en: The apology discount on a substitute is the smallest discount: about 1% when your authority runs 1 to 5%. It is a token of goodwill.

settled.question: What is done if there is no restock date or no substitute
settled.ko: If there is no way to meet it, apologize, say it cannot be done as asked and explain what can: if they wait, it ships on the restock date, with about 2% off for the wait (when your authority runs 1 to 5%).
settled.en: If there is no way to meet it, apologize, say it cannot be done as asked and explain what can: if they wait, it ships on the restock date, with about 2% off for the wait (when your authority runs 1 to 5%).

situation.en: Requested SKU/quantity cannot be fulfilled by the requested ship date and the customer explicitly insists the item must be exact and the date must be met with no substitutes

action.en: Inform the customer of the shortage and inability to meet the date, apologize, and close without offering a substitute, partial shipment, wait option or a quote.

unknowns.en: Whether the worker would ever offer partial shipment or wait if the customer insists
Whether the rule applies only when restock date is after the requested date
What the worker does if the customer later relents

settled.question: Whether the worker would ever offer partial shipment or wait if the customer insists
settled.ko: If the customer insists strongly, do not offer partial shipment or waiting.
settled.en: If the customer insists strongly, do not offer partial shipment or waiting.

settled.question: What the worker does if the customer later relents
settled.ko: If the customer later relents, give the smallest discount, about 1%, as a token of goodwill.
settled.en: If the customer later relents, give the smallest discount, about 1%, as a token of goodwill.

situation.en: Customer provides an SKU that is not found in the catalog

action.en: Check stock for the unknown SKU, receive an unknown_sku error with similar suggestions, check stock for the suggested similar SKU(s), and ask the customer to confirm the intended SKU before proceeding with pricing or quoting.

unknowns.en: How many clarification attempts are made before closing
What happens if the customer confirms an SKU that is still not in catalog
Which similar SKU is picked when multiple are suggested

settled.question: How many clarification attempts are made before closing
settled.ko: Ask once: is it this item, is it one of these, and if not, please describe it a little more. Check what they send back against the catalog, then say it is not available or that this is the item.
settled.en: Ask once: is it this item, is it one of these, and if not, please describe it a little more. Check what they send back against the catalog, then say it is not available or that this is the item.

settled.question: What happens if the customer confirms an SKU that is still not in catalog
settled.ko: If the confirmed code is still not in the catalog, it may not be ours: ask for whatever else they know and say the shop will look into it.
settled.en: If the confirmed code is still not in the catalog, it may not be ours: ask for whatever else they know and say the shop will look into it.

settled.question: Which similar SKU is picked when multiple are suggested
settled.ko: When several similar items come up, ask the customer whether it is one of these; do not pick one. The aim is to find the item they want.
settled.en: When several similar items come up, ask the customer whether it is one of these; do not pick one. The aim is to find the item they want.

situation.en: Customer request does not include an explicit ship-by date

action.en: Ask the customer for an acceptable ship date before checking costs, calculating price or creating a quote; may tell the customer the earliest date the shop could ship.

unknowns.en: Whether the ask is required for all requests or only for multi-line requests
What the worker does if the customer never provides a date
Is phrasing about earliest possible ship date standard

settled.question: Whether the ask is required for all requests or only for multi-line requests
settled.ko: This applies to every request: the ship date matters almost as much as the item. Matching the date the customer has in mind with the date the shop can do comes first.
settled.en: This applies to every request: the ship date matters almost as much as the item. Matching the date the customer has in mind with the date the shop can do comes first.

settled.question: What the worker does if the customer never provides a date
settled.ko: If the customer never gives a date, quote the earliest date the shop can ship and say in the reply that it is the earliest date the shop can offer.
settled.en: If the customer never gives a date, quote the earliest date the shop can ship and say in the reply that it is the earliest date the shop can offer.

settled.question: Is phrasing about earliest possible ship date standard
settled.ko: Telling the customer the earliest ship date is standard; shipping as early as possible also saves storage cost.
settled.en: Telling the customer the earliest ship date is standard; shipping as early as possible also saves storage cost.

situation.en: Customer provides a latest acceptable ship date for a new or reorder order

action.en: Set the quote ship_by date on or before the requested latest date, never later. Typically set 1-2 days earlier than the customer's stated latest, often 1 day earlier for new quotes and 2 days earlier for repeat quotes that reuse an approved price, and often move off weekends.

unknowns.en: Why some records use the exact requested ship date with zero buffer
What determines the exact buffer size
Whether the buffer is calendar days or business days

settled.question: Why some records use the exact requested ship date with zero buffer
settled.ko: A buffer is good: when the customer's latest date is after the earliest date the shop can ship, set the date 1 to 2 days before their latest date.
settled.en: A buffer is good: when the customer's latest date is after the earliest date the shop can ship, set the date 1 to 2 days before their latest date.

settled.question: What determines the exact buffer size
settled.ko: The exact size of the buffer is a judgement call: 1 or 2 days, normally business days.
settled.en: The exact size of the buffer is a judgement call: 1 or 2 days, normally business days.

settled.question: Whether the buffer is calendar days or business days
settled.ko: Count business days (in Korea people say 1 to 2 business days); it may differ by country.
settled.en: Count business days (in Korea people say 1 to 2 business days); it may differ by country.

situation.en: Customer asks to reorder the same quantities as a previous approved quote that is still within its valid_until date

action.en: Look up the previous quote, verify it is approved and valid_until is on or after today, and reuse the previous unit price instead of recalculating price from current cost. Note that the price is from the approved quote.

unknowns.en: Whether the rule applies if the quote expires on the same day as the request
Whether stock is still checked before reusing the price
Whether a cost change or change in discount authority would override reuse

settled.question: Whether the rule applies if the quote expires on the same day as the request
settled.ko: A quote that expires today still counts: a quote holds through its date, so honor it.
settled.en: A quote that expires today still counts: a quote holds through its date, so honor it.

settled.question: Whether stock is still checked before reusing the price
settled.ko: Still check stock and the ship date again: stock can change, and the quote only holds the price.
settled.en: Still check stock and the ship date again: stock can change, and the quote only holds the price.

settled.question: Whether a cost change or change in discount authority would override reuse
settled.ko: A change in cost or discount authority does not override it: an earlier quote within its valid date comes first, and keeping that price keeps the customer's trust.
settled.en: A change in cost or discount authority does not override it: an earlier quote within its valid date comes first, and keeping that price keeps the customer's trust.

situation.en: Customer requests a reorder referencing a previous quote that is expired

action.en: Look up the previous quote, note its expiration, check current stock and cost, create a new quote at today's list/current prices and explicitly inform the customer the previous quote has expired so the new quote is at today's prices. May offer a reorder discount up to worker authority after a price complaint.

unknowns.en: Whether the worker always explicitly notes expiration on every re-quote
Whether a discount is offered proactively or only after a complaint
Whether the worker always recalculates from current cost or sometimes attempts to honor the old price

settled.question: Whether the worker always explicitly notes expiration on every re-quote
settled.ko: Always state clearly that the quote expired, to keep trust and avoid misunderstanding.
settled.en: Always state clearly that the quote expired, to keep trust and avoid misunderstanding.

settled.question: Whether a discount is offered proactively or only after a complaint
settled.ko: Do not offer a discount first. Only after the customer complains and asks for a cut, give the smallest discount (1%), because selling beats not selling.
settled.en: Do not offer a discount first. Only after the customer complains and asks for a cut, give the smallest discount (1%), because selling beats not selling.

settled.question: Whether the worker always recalculates from current cost or sometimes attempts to honor the old price
settled.ko: Always recalculate from the current cost, then discount if needed. Never match the old price.
settled.en: Always recalculate from the current cost, then discount if needed. Never match the old price.

situation.en: Customer questions a price increase on a re-quote or explicitly requests a lower price/discount

action.en: If the discount is within the worker's stated discount authority and at or above the floor price, apply it directly and note the discount % as within authority. If the discount exceeds authority or would go below floor price, ask the owner for permission before offering a reduced price and only proceed if the owner agrees to stay at or above floor. Never quote below floor price. Discounts may be framed as a reorder discount.

unknowns.en: Whether the worker always asks the owner for any discount beyond authority or only when floor would be breached
What discount amount or conditions the owner considers acceptable beyond staying above floor
Whether a discount is offered proactively without an explicit price request

settled.question: Whether the worker always asks the owner for any discount beyond authority or only when floor would be breached
settled.ko: Always ask the owner about any discount beyond your authority.
settled.en: Always ask the owner about any discount beyond your authority.

settled.question: What discount amount or conditions the owner considers acceptable beyond staying above floor
settled.ko: Bring a request to the owner when the customer pushes hard and buys a lot, or is an important customer.
settled.en: Bring a request to the owner when the customer pushes hard and buys a lot, or is an important customer.

settled.question: Whether a discount is offered proactively without an explicit price request
settled.ko: Do not discount without an explicit request. On a re-quote, when the customer explicitly asks for a lower price, give the smallest discount; a regular customer may get a little more. If it goes beyond your authority, judge again and pass it to the owner if the customer seems important.
settled.en: Do not discount without an explicit request. On a re-quote, when the customer explicitly asks for a lower price, give the smallest discount; a regular customer may get a little more. If it goes beyond your authority, judge again and pass it to the owner if the customer seems important.

action.en: Always verify stock sufficiency for the requested qty/sku with check_stock before get_cost/calc_price/create_quote.

unknowns.en: What the worker does if stock is insufficient
Whether stock is re-checked after a discount or SKU clarification
Whether a stock check is skipped for a re-quote of a previously checked item

settled.question: What the worker does if stock is insufficient
settled.ko: If stock is short, say so and first ask whether the earliest possible date works; the rest follows from that.
settled.en: If stock is short, say so and first ask whether the earliest possible date works; the rest follows from that.

settled.question: Whether stock is re-checked after a discount or SKU clarification
settled.ko: Order of work: confirm the item first, then check stock, then discount if a discount is called for.
settled.en: Order of work: confirm the item first, then check stock, then discount if a discount is called for.

settled.question: Whether a stock check is skipped for a re-quote of a previously checked item
settled.ko: Never skip the stock check on a re-quote: stock differs at every moment, and other clerks may be selling the same stock.
settled.en: Never skip the stock check on a re-quote: stock differs at every moment, and other clerks may be selling the same stock.

situation.en: Customer follows up on a request that was previously acknowledged but not yet quoted

action.en: Apologize for the wait referencing the prior acknowledgement date in the reply, then provide the quote.

unknowns.en: Whether an apology is given if there was no prior acknowledgement
How apology wording changes with length of delay
Whether the worker would apologize for a first-time request with no prior note

settled.question: Whether an apology is given if there was no prior acknowledgement
settled.ko: Apologize for any delay even if there was no earlier acknowledgement, and say it will be done as quickly as possible.
settled.en: Apologize for any delay even if there was no earlier acknowledgement, and say it will be done as quickly as possible.

settled.question: How apology wording changes with length of delay
settled.ko: As the delay gets longer, raise the discount a little within your authority, and give a clear reason for the delay.
settled.en: As the delay gets longer, raise the discount a little within your authority, and give a clear reason for the delay.

settled.question: Whether the worker would apologize for a first-time request with no prior note
settled.ko: Apologize on a first-time request too; a customer is a customer.
settled.en: Apologize on a first-time request too; a customer is a customer.
